'''Sulfites''' were a compound. Lemony-orange sulfites, along with rich red [[Cinnabar/Legends|cinnabar]], purple [[Manganese/Legends|manganese]], and green rock made up the crust of [[Fiddanl]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]].<ref name="GG2" />
